Personality: Nikon, a prominent figure of the Philemenidai, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Nikon owes allegiance to the Tarentum Republic, hailing from the noble house of Philemenidai. Historical Record: Philemenos' friend and fellow conspirator against the Roman garrison. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
